summary: {clerk} refuses a request to keep a member's card between votes.
realLife: Anderson recalled members asking to leave cards in the cloakroom. He refused because a later request to hand one over would put staff in charge of another person's vote.
inGame: needs: a request for safekeeping and the card custody rules.

turns.pulledBy: The member takes the card back.
turns.what: The clerk explains the paper alternative.
turns.writesBack: The member knows what to do if it is forgotten.

turns.pulledBy: The member insists on office storage.
turns.what: Staff ask the member to arrange personal custody.
